title: Controller Handoff Schema
description: controller-handoff/v2 (SW-1511A-HANDOFF-001 criterion 1). A typed offered/accepted/active/released-or-rejected state machine that transfers the single controller lease to a server-issued destination principal without carrying provider credentials. The offer records the fencing generation the current controller holds; activation only commits once the destination has acquired a *strictly higher* generation, so a stale or superseded handoff can never carry the lease. v1 manual packages remain readable as offered-only; activation requires v2 acknowledgement.

schema.description: The exact contract identity. Anything else is refused.

handoff_id.description: The opaque handoff identity a receipt references.

destination_principal.description: The server-issued destination principal that receives the lease. Never a caller-supplied authority claim: the server owns this value and the destination must present the same principal to accept.

destination_attestation.description: The destination harness's configured-route and recipient-principal attestation (harness-controller-attestation/v1). Absent or stale attestation is a named HOLD.

scope.description: The exactly-once scope the single living attempt continues. A second live handoff for the same scope is refused.

fencing_generation.description: The lease fencing generation the offering controller holds. Activation commits only against a strictly higher generation, so a stale handoff can never carry the lease.

resulting_generation.description: The fencing generation the destination acquired on activation (strictly greater than fencing_generation); null before activation.

credential_binding.description: A non-secret reference to how the destination reaches its own route (for example gateway://host:port). A provider credential value here is a refusal, never a carried secret; the lease transfer carries no provider credentials.

state.description: The legal states. activated is spelled 'active'; a rejected or released handoff is terminal and can never reactivate.

rejected_reason.description: The named reason a rejected (or cancelled) handoff did not transfer the lease.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative annotations. Never a place to smuggle a credential.

attestationRef.description: A harness-controller-attestation/v1 record (or null when not carried as a sub-object).
